claim: AW25 / A-051 (analytics walk 2026-10-03), founder pick 2026-10-04 ~00:30Z, verbatim "Learn from the POS (Recommended)". Migration tables_learned_from_the_pos (cited by slug, ADR 0235) gives pos_checks a table_ref column holding the till's word, makes restaurant_tables.seats nullable and adds learned_at and hidden_at. A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF table_id, table_ref trigger on pos_checks (WHEN NEW.table_id IS NULL AND NEW.table_ref IS NOT NULL) resolves the word against the house's tables and learns a table when none answers. A DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED constraint trigger re-links earlier unlinked checks to a learned table at commit, and the re-link UPDATE fills only rows with table_id IS NULL, so a link is never moved. The backfill copies the word out of raw for history. Evidence: supabase/tests/<ver>_tables_learned_from_the_pos_test.sql T1-T16 on the local Postgres harness (pgtest.sh lane, p4-scratch/sim-run/fixes/audits/tables-local-pg.txt). The check fails if the migration goes, if any of these clauses goes, or if a later migration drops the learning trigger without re-creating it. Mutation-checked 2026-10-04 against main 1aa4dcb8c (fails) and by deleting the deferred trigger clause (fails).
